name: Board
summary: Kanban boards for each workspace, kept locally or in a folder on one of your connections.
description: Kanban boards for each workspace, in the sidebar: columns, tasks with tags, notes and comments. Keep them locally, or share them through a folder on one of your connections and sync.

versions.changelog: A board on one of your connections syncs by itself: a few seconds after your changes, and every two minutes for everyone else's.
